title: fscale facts --json output
description: The repo facts printed by `fscale facts --json`. Paths are relative to the repo root and always use forward slashes. All lists are sorted.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this format. Changes only on a breaking change.

packageManager.description: The JavaScript package manager of the repo root, from the packageManager field of the root package.json or else from a root lockfile. Null when the root has none; see packageManagers for the projects.

packageManagers.description: Every package manager in use: the root's and each project's.

lockfiles.description: Lockfiles found at the repo root.

languages.description: Languages detected from marker files, at the root and in every project.

tools.description: Build and workspace tools detected from marker files at the repo root.

commands.description: Commands to run from the repo root, for each of the root package.json scripts build, test, lint and typecheck that exists.

projects.description: The projects of the repo, sorted by name: the root, workspace members, and projects found in subfolders.

name.description: The name from the project's manifest, or else the name of its folder. "." for a project at the repo root whose manifest gives no name.

root.description: Repo-relative folder with forward slashes. "." is the repo root.

source.description: How the project was found: it is the repo root, a workspace file at the root lists it, or a marker file was found in a subfolder.

packageManager.description: The project's package manager. Null when a Node project names none and has no lockfile.

lockfiles.description: Names of the lockfiles in the project's folder.

tools.description: Linters, test runners and other tools detected from config files and dependencies in the project's folder.

install.description: Installs the project's dependencies: '<package manager> install' for a Node project that is not a workspace member, and for a Python project the command for its environment (ADR 0022).

commands.description: Commands to run from the project's folder: package scripts first, then commands worked out from tool config files.

dependsOn.description: Names of other projects of the same kind in this repo that this one depends on.

interpreter.description: Python projects only: the interpreter their commands run with, and why (ADR 0022).

source.description: venv: a .venv or venv folder in the project. uv, poetry, pipenv: the project's manager picks the environment. active: the virtual environment named by VIRTUAL_ENV. path: no virtual environment was found, so python from the PATH.

command.description: What each command starts with, for example '.venv/bin/python -m', 'uv run' or 'python -m'.

detail.description: Where the interpreter came from, for people.

warnings.description: Things that were skipped, such as a marker file that is not valid JSON.
